# pvecli ceph log

Tail of the Ceph log.

```text
pvecli ceph log [NODE] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node to read the log from. |

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `-l`, `--limit N` | `50` | Number of lines. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |
